title: केपी खनालले ‘ह्वाट्स एपमा मात्रै कुरा गर्ने’ भनेपछि रुष्ट बनिन् आशिका तामाङ
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टी (रास्वपा) की सांसद आशिका तामाङ आफ्नै पार्टीबाट निर्वाचित अर्का सांसद केपी खनालप्रति रोष व्यक्त गरकी छन् । कारण हो- खनालको मोबाइलमा उनले प्रत्यक्ष सम्पर्क गर्न नसक्नु । आफूले पटक-पटक जनताको मुद्दाबारे कुराकानी गर्न फोन गर्दा खनालका स्वकीयले उठाउने गरेको र ह्वाट्सएपमा कल गर्न भनिएको आशिकाको भनाइ छ । सामाजिक सञ्जालमा स्टाटस लेख्दै उनले खनाललाई जनतासँग फोनमा प्रत्यक्ष उपलब्ध हुन सुझाव दिएकी छन् । उनले लेखेकी छन्, ‘मा. केपी खनाल भाइलाई एउटा जनमुद्दा लिएर फोन गरेको थिएँ । उहाँको स्वकीयले फोन उठाउनु भो । खै केपी भाइलाई फोन दिनुस् भनेको त ह्वाट्‍सएपमा कल गर्नुस्, ह्वाट्सएपबाहेक अरुमा कल उठाउनु हुन्न रे ! म त तीन छक्क परेँ । अरे एउटा जनताबाट निर्वाचित सांसदले संवाद गर्न इन्टरनेट चाहिँदो रहेछ भने सर्वसाधारण नागरिक जो टुकटुके मोबाइल चलाउनुहुन्छ, ती गरिब निमुखाले आफ्नो नेतासम्म गुनासो गर्न कसरी नेट चलाउन सक्नु हुन्छ ।’ आशिकाले यसरी सार्वजनिकरूपमा नै गुनासो गरेपछि केपीले उनलाई कल गरेका छन् । आशिकाका अनुसार उनले आफ्नो काम फोन उठाउने नभएर जनताको मुद्दा उठाउने भएको बताएका थिए । उनले आशिकालाई हर्क साम्पाङको बाटोमा हिँड्न खोजेको आरोप पनि लगाए । त्यसपछि फेरि आशिकाले अर्को स्टाटस लेखेकी छन् । उनी लेख्छिन्, ‘मा. केपी खनाल भाइले कल गर्नु भएर तपाईंले मेरो बदनाम गराउने नियत छ भने अर्को कुरा हो, मेरो काम फोन उठाउने होइन जनताको मुद्दा उठाउने काम हो भन्नू भो । तपाईं पनि मा. हर्क सम्पाङको बाटोमा हिड्नु भाको हो भने छुट्टै कुरो हो दिदी, मलाई कति ठाउँ बाट प्रेसर छ, तपाईंलाई मैले दिदी मानेको थिए भनेर गुनासो गर्नु भो !’ आशिका थप्छिन्, ‘तपाईं मेरो उमेरले भाइ नै हो मैले मानेँ । मेरो प्रश्न तपाईंसँग के हो भने जसरी तपाईंले मलाई फोन गर्दा मसँग सिधै फोनमा कुरा गर्नु भो नि, हो त्यसरी नै अन्य सर्वसाधारण नागरिकले फोन मार्फत समस्या, गुनासो पोख्न पाउनुपर्छ । त्यो तपाईंको ह्वाट्सएपमा मात्रै सिमित नहोस् ! म बुझ्छु कहिलेकाहीँ फोन अफ हुन्छ, मान्छे बिरामी हुन सक्छ तर तपाईँलाई मैले आज मात्र होइन हरेक पल्ट फोन गर्दाखेरि तपाईँको स्वकीयले जहिले मलाई ह्वाट्सएपमा कल गर्नुस् भन्छ । मलाई अप्ठ्यारो लागेर कतिपल्ट त मैले फोनै गरिनँ । तपाईंलाई मात्र कामको प्रेसर हुने भन्ने कदापि हुँदैन ! हामी सबैजना सांसदहरू जनताको सेवा गर्नै आएका हौँ । हिजोको दिन मा तपाईं कसैको छोरा, कसैको भाइ मात्र हुनुहुन्थ्यो होला । तर आज तपाईं तीन करोड जनताको साझा छोरा हुनुहुन्छ ! आफ्नो जनतासँग बोल्नको लागि ह्वाट्सएप कल भनेर कन्डिसन नराख्नुस ! मैले भन्न खोजेको यति हो अरु केही होइन । धन्यवाद !’ Kathmandu. National Independent Party (NISP) MP Ashika Tamang has expressed her anger towards another MP elected from her own party, KP Khanal. The reason is that she has not been able to contact Khanal directly on his mobile phone. Ashika says that when she repeatedly calls to discuss public issues, Khanal's family members pick up the phone and ask her to call them on WhatsApp. Writing a status on social media, she has suggested that Khanal be directly available to the public on the phone. She wrote, 'I called Mr. KP Khanal Bhai about a public issue. His family picked up the phone. When he asked me to give him a phone, I said to call him on WhatsApp, he doesn't pick up calls on anything other than WhatsApp! I was shocked. If an elected MP needs internet to communicate, how can an ordinary citizen who uses a broken mobile phone use the internet to complain to his leader?' After Ashika complained publicly, KP called her. According to Ashika, he said that his job was not to answer the phone but to raise people's issues. He also accused Ashika of trying to follow the path of Hark Sampang. After that, Ashika wrote another status. She writes, 'If you intend to defame me by calling Mr. KP Khanal, that's another matter. My job is not to answer the phone, but to raise people's issues. If you also want to follow the path of Mr. Hark Sampang, that's a different matter, sister, I have pressure from many places, and you are complaining that I considered you my sister!' Ashika adds, 'I think you are my brother by age. My question to you is that just as you wanted to talk to me directly on the phone when you called me, other ordinary citizens should be able to express their problems and complaints over the phone. It should not be limited to your WhatsApp! I understand that sometimes the phone goes off, people may be sick, but not only today, but every time I call you, your loved one tells you to call me on WhatsApp. I didn't call you many times because I felt embarrassed. You are not the only one who has work pressure! All of us MPs have come to serve the people. Yesterday, you may have been someone's son, someone's brother. But today you are the common son of three crore people! Don't condition yourself with WhatsApp calls to talk to your people! That's all I want to say, nothing more. Thank you!'

हामी सबैजना सांसदहरू जनताको सेवा गर्नै आएका हौँ । हिजोको दिन मा तपाईं कसैको छोरा, कसैको भाइ मात्र हुनुहुन्थ्यो होला । तर आज तपाईं तीन करोड जनताको साझा छोरा हुनुहुन्छ ! आफ्नो जनतासँग बोल्नको लागि ह्वाट्सएप कल भनेर कन्डिसन नराख्नुस ! मैले भन्न खोजेको यति हो अरु केही होइन । धन्यवाद !’ Kathmandu. National Independent Party (NISP) MP Ashika Tamang has expressed her anger towards another MP elected from her own party, KP Khanal. The reason is that she has not been able to contact Khanal directly on his mobile phone. Ashika says that when she repeatedly calls to discuss public issues, Khanal's family members pick up the phone and ask her to call them on WhatsApp. Writing a status on social media, she has suggested that Khanal be directly available to the public on the phone. She wrote, 'I called Mr. KP Khanal Bhai about a public issue. His family picked up the phone. When he asked me to give him a phone, I said to call him on WhatsApp, he doesn't pick up calls on anything other than WhatsApp! I was shocked. If an elected MP needs internet to communicate, how can an ordinary citizen who uses a broken mobile phone use the internet to complain to his leader?' After Ashika complained publicly, KP called her. According to Ashika, he said that his job was not to answer the phone but to raise people's issues. He also accused Ashika of trying to follow the path of Hark Sampang. After that, Ashika wrote another status. She writes, 'If you intend to defame me by calling Mr. KP Khanal, that's another matter. My job is not to answer the phone, but to raise people's issues. If you also want to follow the path of Mr. Hark Sampang, that's a different matter, sister, I have pressure from many places, and you are complaining that I considered you my sister!' Ashika adds, 'I think you are my brother by age. My question to you is that just as you wanted to talk to me directly on the phone when you called me, other ordinary citizens should be able to express their problems and complaints over the phone. It should not be limited to your WhatsApp! I understand that sometimes the phone goes off, people may be sick, but not only today, but every time I call you, your loved one tells you to call me on WhatsApp. I didn't call you many times because I felt embarrassed. You are not the only one who has work pressure! All of us MPs have come to serve the people. Yesterday, you may have been someone's son, someone's brother. But today you are the common son of three crore people! Don't condition yourself with WhatsApp calls to talk to your people! That's all I want to say, nothing more. Thank you!'

काठमाडौं । राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टी (रास्वपा) की सांसद आशिका तामाङ आफ्नै पार्टीबाट निर्वाचित अर्का सांसद केपी खनालप्रति रोष व्यक्त गरकी छन् । कारण हो- खनालको मोबाइलमा उनले प्रत्यक्ष सम्पर्क गर्न नसक्नु । आफूले पटक-पटक जनताको मुद्दाबारे कुराकानी गर्न फोन गर्दा खनालका स्वकीयले उठाउने गरेको र ह्वाट्सएपमा कल गर्न भनिएको आशिकाको भनाइ छ । सामाजिक सञ्जालमा स्टाटस लेख्दै उनले खनाललाई जनतासँग फोनमा प्रत्यक्ष उपलब्ध हुन सुझाव दिएकी छन् । उनले लेखेकी छन्, ‘मा. केपी खनाल भाइलाई एउटा जनमुद्दा लिएर फोन गरेको थिएँ । उहाँको स्वकीयले फोन उठाउनु भो । खै केपी भाइलाई फोन दिनुस् भनेको त ह्वाट्‍सएपमा कल गर्नुस्, ह्वाट्सएपबाहेक अरुमा कल उठाउनु हुन्न रे ! म त तीन छक्क परेँ । अरे एउटा जनताबाट निर्वाचित सांसदले संवाद गर्न इन्टरनेट चाहिँदो रहेछ भने सर्वसाधारण नागरिक जो टुकटुके मोबाइल चलाउनुहुन्छ, ती गरिब निमुखाले आफ्नो नेतासम्म गुनासो गर्न कसरी नेट चलाउन सक्नु हुन्छ ।’ आशिकाले यसरी सार्वजनिकरूपमा नै गुनासो गरेपछि केपीले उनलाई कल गरेका छन् । आशिकाका अनुसार उनले आफ्नो काम फोन उठाउने नभएर जनताको मुद्दा उठाउने भएको बताएका थिए । उनले आशिकालाई हर्क साम्पाङको बाटोमा हिँड्न खोजेको आरोप पनि लगाए । त्यसपछि फेरि आशिकाले अर्को स्टाटस लेखेकी छन् । उनी लेख्छिन्, ‘मा. केपी खनाल भाइले कल गर्नु भएर तपाईंले मेरो बदनाम गराउने नियत छ भने अर्को कुरा हो, मेरो काम फोन उठाउने होइन जनताको मुद्दा उठाउने काम हो भन्नू भो । तपाईं पनि मा. हर्क सम्पाङको बाटोमा हिड्नु भाको हो भने छुट्टै कुरो हो दिदी, मलाई कति ठाउँ बाट प्रेसर छ, तपाईंलाई मैले दिदी मानेको थिए भनेर गुनासो गर्नु भो !’ आशिका थप्छिन्, ‘तपाईं मेरो उमेरले भाइ नै हो मैले मानेँ । मेरो प्रश्न तपाईंसँग के हो भने जसरी तपाईंले मलाई फोन गर्दा मसँग सिधै फोनमा कुरा गर्नु भो नि, हो त्यसरी नै अन्य सर्वसाधारण नागरिकले फोन मार्फत समस्या, गुनासो पोख्न पाउनुपर्छ । त्यो तपाईंको ह्वाट्सएपमा मात्रै सिमित नहोस् ! म बुझ्छु कहिलेकाहीँ फोन अफ हुन्छ, मान्छे बिरामी हुन सक्छ तर तपाईँलाई मैले आज मात्र होइन हरेक पल्ट फोन गर्दाखेरि तपाईँको स्वकीयले जहिले मलाई ह्वाट्सएपमा कल गर्नुस् भन्छ । मलाई अप्ठ्यारो लागेर कतिपल्ट त मैले फोनै गरिनँ । तपाईंलाई मात्र कामको प्रेसर हुने भन्ने कदापि हुँदैन ! हामी सबैजना सांसदहरू जनताको सेवा गर्नै आएका हौँ । हिजोको दिन मा तपाईं कसैको छोरा, कसैको भाइ मात्र हुनुहुन्थ्यो होला । तर आज तपाईं तीन करोड जनताको साझा छोरा हुनुहुन्छ ! आफ्नो जनतासँग बोल्नको लागि ह्वाट्सएप कल भनेर कन्डिसन नराख्नुस ! मैले भन्न खोजेको यति हो अरु केही होइन । धन्यवाद !’

Kathmandu. National Independent Party (NISP) MP Ashika Tamang has expressed her anger towards another MP elected from her own party, KP Khanal. The reason is that she has not been able to contact Khanal directly on his mobile phone. Ashika says that when she repeatedly calls to discuss public issues, Khanal's family members pick up the phone and ask her to call them on WhatsApp. Writing a status on social media, she has suggested that Khanal be directly available to the public on the phone. She wrote, 'I called Mr. KP Khanal Bhai about a public issue. His family picked up the phone. When he asked me to give him a phone, I said to call him on WhatsApp, he doesn't pick up calls on anything other than WhatsApp! I was shocked. If an elected MP needs internet to communicate, how can an ordinary citizen who uses a broken mobile phone use the internet to complain to his leader?' After Ashika complained publicly, KP called her. According to Ashika, he said that his job was not to answer the phone but to raise people's issues. He also accused Ashika of trying to follow the path of Hark Sampang. After that, Ashika wrote another status. She writes, 'If you intend to defame me by calling Mr. KP Khanal, that's another matter. My job is not to answer the phone, but to raise people's issues. If you also want to follow the path of Mr. Hark Sampang, that's a different matter, sister, I have pressure from many places, and you are complaining that I considered you my sister!' Ashika adds, 'I think you are my brother by age. My question to you is that just as you wanted to talk to me directly on the phone when you called me, other ordinary citizens should be able to express their problems and complaints over the phone. It should not be limited to your WhatsApp! I understand that sometimes the phone goes off, people may be sick, but not only today, but every time I call you, your loved one tells you to call me on WhatsApp. I didn't call you many times because I felt embarrassed. You are not the only one who has work pressure! All of us MPs have come to serve the people. Yesterday, you may have been someone's son, someone's brother. But today you are the common son of three crore people! Don't condition yourself with WhatsApp calls to talk to your people! That's all I want to say, nothing more. Thank you!'
